grouping: Translations of one scenario stay together. This draft is authored from scenario families and parameterized windows; it is not independent human ground truth. The final partition must never guide model, prompt or retrieval selection.
selection: Freeze candidate code, model, prompt and corpus before opening final results. Development smoke is a mocked execution contract check, not a model benchmark.
review_gate: A reviewer independent of the project authors must approve every bilingual scenario, expected plan, relevance label and translation before freezing or any live-provider benchmark. Exact scenario, protocol, corpus and review hashes are recorded. Agent-authored scores never count as human review.

pair_review.selection: Two leagues by three analytical intents by two languages; blinded A/B assignment based on a frozen pair hash.

limitations: Targets are proposed acceptance thresholds, not achieved results. Translated variants are correlated and do not double the number of independent semantic scenarios. Numerical verification checks deterministic tools; it does not establish independent human judgment or causal truth. No generalization claim is made for this draft.
